changelog: Say "smiley emoji" — or "হাসি ইমোজি" in Bengali — alone while dictating in WhatsApp or Messenger and the keyboard inserts the emoji into your message, so emoji no longer need a reach for the emoji panel mid-dictation. 24 emoji with English and Bengali names (smiley, heart, thumbs up, fire, clapping, praying, crying, angry, party, rose, and more). Gboard only offers this on Pixel phones in English; here it works on any phone in both languages. Saying the name inside a longer sentence still types it as normal text, and a bare name like "fire" is just typed too — only the word "emoji" makes it a command.
